meta.title: Dono — Match and Review an Offer

segments.label: 1 · Match — need + capacity + season + Haversine, no AI
2 · Offer — revalidate current eligibility before committing
3 · Human review — original evidence and overrides shown together

messages.label: Coordinates / error
messages.note: Unknown location stays unknown; no invented distance. Precision/fallback: AMB-016.

messages.label: Read match inputs
messages.note: Read current working facts, approved associations, confirmed needs, category capacity and season. Expose only a limited listing to donors.

messages.label: Eligible matches
messages.note: Code computes eligibility, Haversine distances and ordering/reasons. No model is called. Radius/ties/weights: AMB-009; capacity units/timing: AMB-008.

messages.label: Matches / options
messages.note: No match: show other options. Medicine concern points to pharmacy; no transport, route planning or outbound messages.

messages.label: Recheck + offer
messages.note: Enforce owner, association approval and current eligibility/capacity. Commit once; conflicts return current state. Offer cardinality: AMB-012.

messages.label: Review details
messages.note: Compute expiry days/buckets at read time. Show original provider/model/category, fixed indicators/confidence, corrections and potential category mismatch.

messages.label: Approve OR refuse
messages.note: Only association personnel choose the donation decision. High confidence is not approval; a confirmed medicine cannot be approved as an exception.

messages.label: Guard + commit
messages.note: Check target membership, current state and agreed capacity rules. Save human actor/decision; preserve AI evidence. Conflicting reviews cannot silently overwrite.

messages.label: Staff decision
messages.note: Approved enables booking; refused does not. Reads stay in-app. Reversal/re-offering remain AMB-012.

cards.title: Deterministic matching · BR-003
items: Need, capacity, season and distance are code inputs. There is deliberately no model participant in this sequence.
Eligibility and distance ordering use validated working facts, not a rewritten AI record.

cards.title: Evidence remains attributable
items: Staff see original provider/model/category and unedited indicators next to human changes.
Category mismatch remains explicit; staff can disagree without overwriting the AI original.

cards.title: Human decision boundary · BR-001
items: Only authorized target-association staff can approve/refuse. No donor or provider writes decision.
FR-013–FR-017; UC-006–UC-008. Capacity reservations, expiry policy and reversals remain open.
